subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an opt-in `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` contract for model-provider dispatch before the broader outbound rate-limit design is settled?
rationale: The PR adds a public config/API surface and runtime failure mode that automation cannot safely bless without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor branch now and invite a refreshed PR after a maintainer explicitly sponsors the provider-dispatch-only contract.

options.title: Sponsor Provider Dispatch First
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or ask for a refreshed branch that keeps this narrow model-provider scope and documents follow-up exclusions.

options.title: Design Broader Governance First
options.body: Pause provider-dispatch implementation until rate limits, budgets, CLI/status, tools/search, and channel/plugin calls are scoped together.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor branch now and invite a refreshed PR after a maintainer explicitly sponsors the provider-dispatch-only contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on adjacent provider egress/config behavior and the shortlog points to them as the central area owner signal.
